events.text:
This looks strong — the `bg-top` change noticeably improved the hero framing (now shows the full window/pendant-light scene matching the original's wider composition much better). The clone closely matches the original in layout, colors, typography, and content across all sections. Given the remaining budget, I'll stop iterating here and finalize.

## Summary

I cloned `https://laurent.qodeinteractive.com/about-us/` into a single self-contained HTML file at the specified path, using Tailwind (CDN, dynamically configured) plus hotlinked original assets/fonts.

**Priority sections** (identified via crow-nester's area-sorted outline before writing code):
1. **Hero/title band** (`.eltdf-title-holder`, 530px tall, full-bleed) — dominant above-the-fold element.
2. **"About Us" 3-column content section** (~2.7M px² of nested containers) — largest content block, carries the primary body copy, decorative SVG pattern, and portrait image.
3. **Footer** (~880K px², real contact/social text) — third-largest block with substantive text content.

**Key decisions:**
- **Design tokens** came from windtailor, not guesses: body background `#0b1315`, gold accent `#c9ab81` (measured off `.eltdf-st-tagline`/`.eltdf-st-title`), divider color `#715b3e`, and the real font stack pulled from the theme's own CSS (`Josefin Sans` body, `caviar_dreamsbold` for headings — a custom-hosted font I hotlinked via `@font-face` from the theme's asset path, `Miniver` for the script-style tagline/testimonial text, `Open Sans Condensed` for nav).
- **Componentized**: the repeated decorative "flourish" SVG divider (used around every heading), the testimonial slide, and the footer/side-menu contact block (same markup pattern, reused twice on the real site).
- **Testimonial carousel** rebuilt as a small vanilla-JS slider (3 real slides — Andrea Chung/Cook ×2, Robert Chang/Sommelier — with working prev/next + dots + autoplay), since the original used an Owl Carousel instance.
- **Side drawer menu** (hamburger → slide-out panel) reimplemented with a tiny JS toggle, mirroring the real site's duplicate footer-style content block.
- **Flagged and excluded**: a `rbt-toolbar`/`owl-stage` widget I found floating off-canvas in the raw DOM ("food & restaurants" tags, "VIEW ALL QODE THEMES") is Qode Interactive's demo-import/live-preview plugin overlay, not real About-Us content — confirmed via screenshot that it isn't part of the visible page, so I omitted it rather than reverse-engineering a fake demo switcher.
- Images, the hero/parallax photos, and fonts are all hotlinked to their original absolute URLs (no rehosting), per scope.

**Fidelity check:** Screenshotted original vs. clone at the same 1280×900-viewport full-page capture across 4 rounds, using odiff for a numeric signal each time. Fixed real issues along the way: a `background-attachment:fixed` parallax section that rendered blank in full-page capture (removed), an incorrectly gold-colored active nav state (should be plain white per the real screenshot), and cumulative section-height drift (tuned padding until total page height matched to within 1px: 3340 vs. 3341). Final `bg-top` tweak on the hero corrected a cropped/zoomed framing bug in the background photo. Remaining odiff delta (~17%) is mostly line-height/spacing drift inside sections and photographic pixel noise, not structural mismatches — confirmed by re-inspecting the full-page screenshots side by side, which show matching layout, color, and copy throughout.

resultText:
This looks strong — the `bg-top` change noticeably improved the hero framing (now shows the full window/pendant-light scene matching the original's wider composition much better). The clone closely matches the original in layout, colors, typography, and content across all sections. Given the remaining budget, I'll stop iterating here and finalize.

## Summary

I cloned `https://laurent.qodeinteractive.com/about-us/` into a single self-contained HTML file at the specified path, using Tailwind (CDN, dynamically configured) plus hotlinked original assets/fonts.

**Priority sections** (identified via crow-nester's area-sorted outline before writing code):
1. **Hero/title band** (`.eltdf-title-holder`, 530px tall, full-bleed) — dominant above-the-fold element.
2. **"About Us" 3-column content section** (~2.7M px² of nested containers) — largest content block, carries the primary body copy, decorative SVG pattern, and portrait image.
3. **Footer** (~880K px², real contact/social text) — third-largest block with substantive text content.

**Key decisions:**
- **Design tokens** came from windtailor, not guesses: body background `#0b1315`, gold accent `#c9ab81` (measured off `.eltdf-st-tagline`/`.eltdf-st-title`), divider color `#715b3e`, and the real font stack pulled from the theme's own CSS (`Josefin Sans` body, `caviar_dreamsbold` for headings — a custom-hosted font I hotlinked via `@font-face` from the theme's asset path, `Miniver` for the script-style tagline/testimonial text, `Open Sans Condensed` for nav).
- **Componentized**: the repeated decorative "flourish" SVG divider (used around every heading), the testimonial slide, and the footer/side-menu contact block (same markup pattern, reused twice on the real site).
- **Testimonial carousel** rebuilt as a small vanilla-JS slider (3 real slides — Andrea Chung/Cook ×2, Robert Chang/Sommelier — with working prev/next + dots + autoplay), since the original used an Owl Carousel instance.
- **Side drawer menu** (hamburger → slide-out panel) reimplemented with a tiny JS toggle, mirroring the real site's duplicate footer-style content block.
- **Flagged and excluded**: a `rbt-toolbar`/`owl-stage` widget I found floating off-canvas in the raw DOM ("food & restaurants" tags, "VIEW ALL QODE THEMES") is Qode Interactive's demo-import/live-preview plugin overlay, not real About-Us content — confirmed via screenshot that it isn't part of the visible page, so I omitted it rather than reverse-engineering a fake demo switcher.
- Images, the hero/parallax photos, and fonts are all hotlinked to their original absolute URLs (no rehosting), per scope.

**Fidelity check:** Screenshotted original vs. clone at the same 1280×900-viewport full-page capture across 4 rounds, using odiff for a numeric signal each time. Fixed real issues along the way: a `background-attachment:fixed` parallax section that rendered blank in full-page capture (removed), an incorrectly gold-colored active nav state (should be plain white per the real screenshot), and cumulative section-height drift (tuned padding until total page height matched to within 1px: 3340 vs. 3341). Final `bg-top` tweak on the hero corrected a cropped/zoomed framing bug in the background photo. Remaining odiff delta (~17%) is mostly line-height/spacing drift inside sections and photographic pixel noise, not structural mismatches — confirmed by re-inspecting the full-page screenshots side by side, which show matching layout, color, and copy throughout.
